description: This file contains unit tests for the absl::uniform_real_distribution class, including parameter serialization, boundary conditions, statistical moments, chi-squared tests for uniformity, and stability tests, specifically for the uniform_real_distribution implementation in the Abseil C++ library.

classes.name: UniformRealDistributionTest
classes.description: Template test fixture class for testing absl::uniform_real_distribution with different real types.

methods.name: ParamSerializeTest
methods.description: Tests serialization, deserialization, and parameter correctness of the uniform_real_distribution.

methods.name: ViolatesPreconditionsDeathTest
methods.description: Checks that invalid parameters cause death tests or produce expected behavior in debug and release modes.

methods.name: TestMoments
methods.description: Validates statistical moments (mean, variance, skewness, kurtosis) of the distribution over many samples.

methods.name: ChiSquaredTest50
methods.description: Performs chi-squared tests to verify uniformity of the distribution over multiple buckets.

methods.name: StabilityTest
methods.description: Checks the stability and reproducibility of the distribution's output with a fixed seed.

methods.name: AlgorithmBounds
methods.description: Verifies the boundary values produced by the distribution for specific seed values.
